comment: Documented exceptions for the production npm-audit release gate (scripts/audit-gate.cjs). Each entry allowlists ONE advisory (by GHSA id) that is confirmed upstream-blocked: no direct dependency bump or npm override in THIS repo can remediate it. Any advisory NOT listed here still fails the gate at the moderate+ threshold. Every entry must carry the reason it is not remediable here, the condition that clears it, and the date it was reviewed. Re-verify entries at every release: remove an entry as soon as its upstream fix lands (the gate warns on stale entries that no longer match anything).

exceptions.reason: Vulnerable brace-expansion@5.0.7 is nested inside @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, whose published npm-shrinkwrap.json freezes its transitive tree; by npm design a shrinkwrap is authoritative, so a downstream override cannot replace it (re-verified empirically 2026-08-03 against pi-coding-agent@0.83.0 — the LATEST release: adding a brace-expansion override to this repo updated the top-level copy to 5.0.9 but left the nested-in-shrinkwrap copy pinned at 5.0.7, so the advisory still fires). Exposure is a DoS via unbounded expansion of glob patterns inside pi's own CLI internals — not attacker-controlled input in pi-research's usage.
exceptions.clearsWhen: pi-coding-agent publishes a release whose shrinkwrap pulls brace-expansion >=5.0.9 (5.0.8 is NOT sufficient — it is itself in the vulnerable range 4.0.0–5.0.8 for the companion GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895 bypass; the fix landed in 5.0.9).

exceptions.reason: Same root cause and same frozen location as GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg: brace-expansion@5.0.7 nested inside @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@0.83.0's authoritative npm-shrinkwrap.json. This advisory is the bypass of the CVE-2026-14257 mitigation that the companion advisory covers, and it widens the vulnerable range to 4.0.0–5.0.8 (so the previously-assumed 5.0.8 fix is itself vulnerable). Re-verified empirically 2026-08-03 that a downstream `overrides` entry cannot replace the nested copy (it stays at 5.0.7); the only remediation is an upstream pi-coding-agent release whose shrinkwrap pulls brace-expansion >=5.0.9. Same unreachable-code exposure (DoS on glob patterns in pi's CLI internals, not attacker-controlled input in pi-research).
exceptions.clearsWhen: pi-coding-agent publishes a release whose shrinkwrap pulls brace-expansion >=5.0.9.

exceptions.reason: sharp <0.35.0 (libvips CVEs) is a direct dependency of @huggingface/transformers, which pi-research uses exclusively for TEXT embeddings (knowledge store); the sharp image-processing pipeline is never invoked, so the vulnerable code path is unreachable in this package. Forcing sharp 0.35 via an override would deviate a native module from the upstream-tested combination on a code path our test suite cannot exercise — higher regression risk than the unreachable advisory.
exceptions.clearsWhen: @huggingface/transformers publishes a release depending on sharp >=0.35.0 (transformers is deliberately pinned at 4.2.x in this repo; re-evaluate at the next planned transformers bump).
